action.question: On the funds page, the row action icons currently show for everyone with no role check. For a beneficiary like LUser1 (owner of account 7), what should the icons do?

questions.question: On the funds page, the row action icons currently show for everyone with no role check. For a beneficiary like LUser1 (owner of account 7), what should the icons do?

options.label: Gate by permission
options.description: Add per-icon @can guards so each action (Trade Bands, Rebalance, Edit Allocations, Edit, Delete, New Fund) only renders for users allowed to do it. A beneficiary would see just View. This is the 'review icon visibility' part too.

options.label: Scope links to account 7
options.description: Swap the admin icons for ones that open the viewing user's own account view/performance within that fund (account-scoped), instead of fund-wide admin pages.

options.label: Both: gate + scope
options.description: Hide admin icons the beneficiary can't use AND add an account-scoped 'my account in this fund' link/icon for them.

questions.question: On the dashboard, where should 'funds first' apply? (The manager card grid already shows the Funds card first; the beneficiary 'My Account' card lists My Accounts → My Transactions → My Fund, so Fund is last there.)

options.label: Beneficiary card: Fund first
options.description: Reorder the beneficiary 'My Account' card to My Fund → My Accounts → My Transactions. (LUser1 sees this view.)

options.label: Manager grid: Funds first
options.description: Make the Funds card first in the manager grid. Note: it already is first, so this would be a confirm/no-op.

options.label: Both views
options.description: Put funds first in both the beneficiary card and the manager grid.

transcript_tail.text: I'll explore the codebase to understand the three pages involved before making changes. Let me look at the dashboard, funds, and accounts/portfolios views.

The icons in the screenshot (eye, wave-square, chart-line, balance-scale, edit, trash) match the **funds** actions partial exactly, plus a "Portfolios" badge. Let me read the actual files to pin down which page the screenshot shows and understand the current markup.

The funds-index table (columns Id, Name, Goal, **Portfolios**, **Action**) with that exact icon set matches the screenshot. But request #3 says "on the funds page **also** review icon visibility" — implying the screenshot (#1) is a *different* page that reuses the same icons. Let me check where else this icon set / the account-show page renders these, and learn who LUser1 / account 7 is.
`funds.actions` is only used by the funds table, and there's no `resources/views/accounts/` dir. Let me locate the accounts views and confirm what page LUser1 sees.

Now I have the lay of the land. `funds.table` is rendered only by `funds/index.blade.php`, so the screenshot is the **funds index page** (`/funds`) — columns Id/Name/Goal/**Portfolios**/**Action**, with those exact action icons. Requests #1 and #3 are both about this page; #2 is the dashboard.

Let me quickly read how the funds list is authorized/filtered and confirm who LUser1 / account 7 is, so my clarifying questions are grounded.

I've confirmed the layout. The screenshot is the **funds index page** (`/funds`) — it's the only place `funds.table` renders, and its columns (Id/Name/Goal/**Portfolios**/**Action**) plus the icon set (view, trade-bands, rebalance, allocations, edit, delete) match exactly. So requests #1 and #3 are both about that page; #2 is the dashboard.

Key facts I found:
- **Funds page icons** (`funds/actions.blade.php`) have **no role/`@can` guards** — every viewer sees Edit/Delete/Trade-Bands/Rebalance/Allocations, even a beneficiary who'd get a 403 on click. The funds *list* itself is already authorization-filtered, but the icons aren't. The "New Fund" button is also ungated.
- **Dashboard** already renders **Funds first** for managers; a beneficiary (which LUser1 appears to be — owner of account 7) sees only a "My Account" card listing *Accounts → Transactions → Fund* (Fund is last).

Two parts hinge on what you actually want, so let me confirm before changing outward-facing UI:

expected.rec_session: Gate by permission, Beneficiary card: Fund first
